title: Northloop Payments Collections Note: Card Charge and Referral of a Negative Balance
content:
**Rule.** When the Northloop Payments balance has stayed below zero for more than the plan's negative balance card charge days, the card on file is charged for the full deficit. A declined charge is retried up to the retry count, one attempt per business day. A deficit still unpaid after the negative balance collection days is referred for collection; the card is not charged again by this account.

## How the days below zero are counted

The days below zero are the calendar days elapsed since the negative-since date, the day after that date counting as day one; they are 0 when the account shows no negative-since date. The count runs to the handling date.

## Points of judgement

| Days below zero, against the plan's card charge days | Card on file charged for the full deficit |
|---|---|
| equal to or fewer than the card charge days | no |
| more than the card charge days | yes |

- *Declined charge.* It is retried, one attempt per business day, up to the plan's retry count.
- *Deficit still unpaid after the collection days.* It is referred for collection, and this account does not charge the card again.

*Hypothetical boundary, Payments Weekly (30 card charge days).* A balance whose negative-since date is day N is on its 30th day below zero on day N plus 30, which is not more than 30, so no card charge is due on that count; on day N plus 31 it is on its 31st day, more than 30, and the card on file is charged for the full deficit.
